_published_faq.name: How do I add workers-bindings to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add workers-bindings to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://bindings.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is workers-bindings MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, workers-bindings scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is workers-bindings's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, workers-bindings scores 61/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 23 of 23 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to workers-bindings?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to workers-bindings in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
